title: Magical Kashmir: Royal Houseboats & Snowy Gulmarg
overview: Experience the enchanting beauty of Kashmir with luxury stays in Srinagar floating houseboats, Gondola rides in Gulmarg, and serene walks through Pahalgam valleys.
highlights: Complimentary Shikara ride on Dal Lake with flower decoration
Luxury Houseboat stay with candle-light dinner
Gondola Phase 1 & Phase 2 tickets included
Private AC Sedan/SUV for all transfers
inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in 4-Star handpicked hotels & houseboats
Private airport transfers and sightseeing vehicle
Driver allowances, toll, parking, and GST
exclusions: Pahalgam local union cab for Aru/Betaab valley

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Sunset Shikara Ride
itinerary.description: Arrive at Srinagar Airport where our private representative greets you. Transfer to your luxury Houseboat on Dal Lake. In the evening, enjoy a romantic 1-hour Shikara ride.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg Excursion
itinerary.description: Drive to Gulmarg, the Meadow of Flowers. Board the world's second-highest Gondola cable car ride up to Apharwat Peak for breathtaking snow vistas.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Mughal Gardens & Heritage Walk
itinerary.description: Visit Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, and Pari Mahal. Explore Pampore saffron fields and local Kashmiri handicraft centres.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam (Valley of Shepherds)
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam along the Lidder River. Visit Betaab Valley (named after the Bollywood movie) and Aru Valley surrounded by pine forests.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Exploration & Return to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Morning pony ride to Baisaran Meadow (Mini Switzerland). Return to Srinagar in the afternoon for leisure shopping in Lal Chowk.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty Kashmiri breakfast (Kahwa + Girda) before being transferred to Srinagar Airport for your return journey.

title: Leh-Ladakh Expedition: Pangong Lake & Nubra Valley
overview: Embark on the ultimate Ladakh road adventure — Khardung La, the sapphire Pangong Lake, double-hump camel safari in Nubra Valley, ancient monasteries, and a night under a billion stars at 14,000 feet.
highlights: Pangong Tso Lake overnight camping at 4,350m
Khardung La Pass (5,359m) crossing — world's highest
Nubra Valley Camel Safari on Bactrian Camels
Thiksey Monastery sunrise prayer ceremony
inclusions: 6 Nights stay (mix of hotels, guesthouses & tent camps)
Private Innova/SUV with experienced Ladakhi driver
Inner Line Permits for Pangong & Nubra

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh & Acclimatisation Rest
itinerary.description: Arrive at Leh Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport (ALH). Transfer to hotel. Full day rest for high-altitude acclimatisation. Short walk to Leh Market & Shanti Stupa in the evening.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing — Monasteries Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Hemis Monastery (Ladakh's largest), Thiksey Monastery (resembling Potala Palace), Shey Palace, and Rancho's School (3 Idiots filming location).

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.description: Drive over the legendary Khardung La (5,359m). Descend into Nubra Valley. Afternoon camel safari on Bactrian camels in the cold desert of Hunder. Overnight in camp/guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley to Pangong Lake
itinerary.description: Cross Shyok River to reach the iconic Pangong Tso (4,350m). Watch the lake change colours from turquoise to blue to green. Overnight tent camping by the lake shore.

itinerary.title: Pangong Sunrise & Return to Leh
itinerary.description: Wake up to the magical Pangong sunrise. Return via Chang La Pass (5,360m). Afternoon rest in Leh.

itinerary.title: Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib & Hall of Fame
itinerary.description: Half-day local excursion covering Magnetic Hill (gravity-defying road), Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, and the Indian Army Hall of Fame Museum.

itinerary.title: Departure from Leh
itinerary.description: Early morning transfer to Leh Airport for departure with memories that will last a lifetime.

title: Shimla-Manali Delight: Toy Train & Snow Valley
overview: The classic Himachal Pradesh holiday — Shimla's colonial charm + Manali's snow peaks. Ride the UNESCO Kalka-Shimla Toy Train, play in Solang Valley snow, and cross through Atal Tunnel to Sissu.
highlights: UNESCO Kalka-Shimla Toy Train Ride (Heritage Experience)
Rohtang Pass Snow Excursion (permit included)
Solang Valley Paragliding & Snow Activities
Mall Road Shimla & Hadimba Temple Manali
inclusions: Deluxe Volvo bus Delhi–Shimla–Manali–Delhi or private cab
exclusions: Airfare if opting for Chandigarh fly-in

itinerary.title: Arrival in Shimla — Queen of Hills
itinerary.description: Arrive in Shimla by Volvo/cab. Check in to hotel. Evening stroll on Mall Road and The Ridge, with views of colonial Christ Church.

itinerary.title: Shimla Sightseeing & Toy Train Experience
itinerary.description: Visit Jakhu Temple (Hanuman ji idol), Kufri Potato Farm & mini zoo, Chail Palace. Evening toy train ride on a scenic section of the Kalka-Shimla Heritage Railway.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali Scenic Drive
itinerary.description: Drive along Beas River through Kullu Valley. Stop at Kullu Shawl factory and Vaishno Devi Temple en route. Arrive Manali by evening.

itinerary.title: Manali to Rohtang Pass / Atal Tunnel & Sissu
itinerary.description: Early drive to Rohtang Pass (permit needed) for snowplay. Drive through Atal Tunnel (9.02 km) to Sissu Waterfall in Lahaul Valley — breathtaking views.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Old Manali Walk
itinerary.description: Morning paragliding in Solang Valley. Visit Hadimba Devi Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs, and Old Manali's famous backpacker cafes.

itinerary.title: Departure from Manali
itinerary.description: After breakfast, board your return Volvo or private cab back to Delhi with beautiful Himalayan memories.

title: Goa Beach & Heritage Holiday: Sun, Sand & Spice
overview: Soak in Goa's golden beaches, Portuguese heritage, Konkani seafood, and the famous Dudhsagar Waterfall. Perfect for families, couples, and friends wanting an ultimate Indian beach getaway.
highlights: North Goa beach hopping: Calangute, Baga, Anjuna & Vagator
Dudhsagar Falls Jeep Safari through Bhagwan Mahavir Sanctuary
Old Goa UNESCO Heritage Churches — Se Cathedral & Basilica of Bom Jesus
Sunset Cruise on Mandovi River with live Goan music
inclusions: Airport pickup & drop in private cab
Dudhsagar Jeep Safari with entry ticket
exclusions: Water sports activities (parasailing, jet ski, banana boat)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa & North Beach Relaxation
itinerary.description: Arrive at Goa Airport (GOI). Transfer to hotel. Afternoon leisure at Calangute/Baga Beach. Evening Mandovi River Sunset Cruise with live Goan folk music & Konkani snacks.

itinerary.title: North Goa Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Fort Aguada, Chapora Fort (Dil Chahta Hai fame), Anjuna Flea Market, and watch the Vagator Beach sunset. Evening at Thalassa (famous Greek sunset restaurant).

itinerary.title: Dudhsagar Waterfall Jeep Safari
itinerary.description: Full-day jeep safari through the dense Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary to the four-tiered 310-metre Dudhsagar Falls. Swimming at the base. Spice plantation lunch en route.

itinerary.title: Old Goa Heritage & South Goa Beaches
itinerary.description: Morning visit to UNESCO heritage Se Cathedral, Basilica of Bom Jesus (St. Francis Xavier's remains), and Mangueshi Temple. Afternoon at serene Palolem or Colva beach in South Goa.

itinerary.title: Leisure Morning & Departure
itinerary.description: Free morning for beach walk or souvenir shopping at Mapusa Market. Transfer to Goa Airport for departure.

title: Royal Rajasthan Circuit: Jaipur, Jodhpur & Jaisalmer
overview: A grand circuit of Rajasthan's most iconic royal cities — the Pink City of Jaipur, the Blue City of Jodhpur, and the golden dunes of Jaisalmer — complete with palace hotel stays and a sunset camel safari.
highlights: Amber Fort elephant ride & City Palace Jaipur
Mehrangarh Fort Jodhpur & Ghanta Ghar Clock Tower
Jaisalmer Fort (Living Fort) & Patwon ki Haveli
Sam Sand Dunes Camel Safari & Desert Camp with folk music
inclusions: 7 Nights in Heritage/Boutique hotels & 1 Night Desert Camp
Private AC sedan for entire circuit
Amber Fort Jeep ride (instead of elephant optional)
Desert camp entry with dinner & cultural program

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur — Pink City Welcome
itinerary.description: Arrive in Jaipur. Transfer to heritage hotel. Evening visit to Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds) for photos and Johri Bazaar for Rajasthani jewellery.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Sightseeing — Forts & Palaces
itinerary.description: Amber Fort (Amer Qila) with Sheesh Mahal, City Palace Museum, Jantar Mantar UNESCO Observatory, and Ram Niwas Garden. Evening aarti at Govind Dev Ji Temple.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur — The Blue City
itinerary.description: Drive to Jodhpur via Ajmer (optional Dargah visit). Check in to hotel. Evening walk in the old blue-walled lanes of Navchokiya and dinner at Indique rooftop with fort view.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur Sightseeing — Mehrangarh & Markets
itinerary.description: Explore the imposing Mehrangarh Fort with its stunning museum, Jaswant Thada marble cenotaph, Ghanta Ghar Clock Tower, and Sardar Market spice bazaar.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to Jaisalmer — The Golden City
itinerary.description: Drive to Jaisalmer through the Thar Desert. Check in to fort-view hotel. Afternoon visit to Patwon ki Haveli and the living Jaisalmer Fort.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Desert Safari & Camp Night
itinerary.description: Afternoon camel safari at Sam Sand Dunes. Watch the breathtaking Rajasthan desert sunset. Overnight luxury desert camp with Rajasthani folk dancers, fire show & open-sky dinner.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer to Udaipur Drive (or Departure)
itinerary.description: Drive to Udaipur (City of Lakes) or prepare for departure. Visit Gadisar Lake before leaving Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Departure from Jaisalmer / Udaipur
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to airport/railway station for homeward journey carrying royal Rajasthani memories forever.

title: Enchanting Kerala: Munnar Hills & Alleppey Backwaters
overview: Immerse your family in lush green tea gardens of Munnar, spice plantations of Thekkady, and an unforgettable overnight luxury houseboat cruise through Alleppey's palm-fringed backwaters.
highlights: Overnight stay in private deluxe Houseboat with all meals
Munnar Tea Museum & Mattupetty Dam visit
Kathakali cultural dance performance in Thekkady
Spice Garden Guided Walking Tour
inclusions: 4 Nights Hotel stay + 1 Night Houseboat stay
Daily breakfast at hotels, all meals on Houseboat
Private AC cab for full trip
exclusions: Boating fee at Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary

itinerary.title: Cochin Arrival & Transfer to Munnar
itinerary.description: Pick up from Cochin Airport/Railway Station and drive to Munnar. En route, stop at Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Full day tour covering Eravikulam National Park (home to Nilgiri Tahr), Tea Museum, Echo Point, and Mattupetty Dam.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady (Wild Elephant Country)
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Thekkady. Visit spice gardens. Evening Kathakali & Kalaripayattu martial arts show.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.description: Drive to Alleppey jetty. Board private luxury houseboat by noon. Enjoy traditional Kerala sadhya meals on board while gliding through palm-fringed canals.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Fort Kochi Heritage Walk
itinerary.description: Disembark houseboat after breakfast. Drive to Cochin. Sightseeing at Fort Kochi, iconic Chinese Fishing Nets, and Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace).

itinerary.title: Departure from Cochin
itinerary.description: Transfer to Cochin Airport/Railway Station with beautiful memories of God's Own Country.

title: Goa Honeymoon Escape: Beachfront Bliss & Sunset Cruise
overview: A perfectly curated romantic escape for newlyweds — private beachfront villa, romantic candlelit dinner on the beach, sunset yacht cruise, and couple spa treatment in Goa's most serene corners.
highlights: Candlelit beach dinner with private chef
Private sunset yacht cruise with champagne
Couple's Ayurvedic body massage & spa
South Goa's quiet Palolem & Butterfly Beach

itinerary.title: Arrival & Beachfront Check-In
itinerary.description: Arrive at Goa Airport. Transfer to boutique beachfront resort. Welcome with fresh coconut & flower decoration room. Evening stroll on private beach.

itinerary.title: Sunset Yacht Cruise & Candlelit Dinner
itinerary.description: Relax by pool in the morning. Afternoon private sunset yacht cruise along Goa coastline. Evening candlelit dinner on the beach with live guitar music.

itinerary.title: Couple Spa & South Goa Exploration
itinerary.description: Morning 60-min couple Ayurvedic spa. Afternoon drive to serene South Goa — Palolem Beach, Butterfly Beach, and Cabo de Rama Fort for panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Departure
itinerary.description: Late breakfast by the beach. Free time for souvenir shopping before airport transfer. Depart with hearts full of beautiful memories.

title: Andaman Island Odyssey: Havelock & Neil Island
overview: Discover India's finest tropical island archipelago — crystal lagoons, pristine reefs, the historic Cellular Jail, Asia's best beach at Radhanagar, scuba diving, and bioluminescent plankton night experience.
highlights: Radhanagar Beach — Asia's Best Beach (TIME Magazine)
Scuba Diving at Elephant Beach (crystal clear coral reefs)
Cellular Jail Light & Sound Show
Neil Island — Natural Bridge & Glass-Bottom Boat
inclusions: 5 Nights (Port Blair + Havelock + Neil Island) in beach resorts
Cellular Jail Light & Sound Show ticket

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair & Cellular Jail Visit
itinerary.description: Arrive at Veer Savarkar International Airport, Port Blair. Transfer to hotel. Evening visit to the historic Cellular Jail and its emotional Light & Sound Show.

itinerary.title: Port Blair to Havelock Island
itinerary.description: Morning government ferry or private speedboat to Havelock Island. Check in to beach resort. Afternoon relaxation at Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7) — stunning sunset.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Snorkelling & Scuba Diving
itinerary.description: Glass-bottom boat to Elephant Beach. Snorkelling over vibrant coral reefs. Optional Scuba Diving (extra cost) at some of Asia's most pristine dive sites.

itinerary.title: Havelock to Neil Island
itinerary.description: Ferry to Neil Island. Visit Natural Bridge rock formation, Bharatpur Beach (crystal lagoon), and Laxmanpur Beach for the famous sunset view.

itinerary.title: Neil Island Relaxation & Return to Port Blair
itinerary.description: Peaceful morning at Neil Island. Evening ferry back to Port Blair. Shopping at Aberdeen Bazaar for shells, pearls, and Andaman handicrafts.

itinerary.title: Departure from Port Blair
itinerary.description: Morning transfer to airport. Depart with memories of India's most pristine tropical paradise.

title: Spiritual Varanasi & Prayagraj: Ganga Aarti Pilgrimage
overview: Walk through Varanasi's 84 sacred ghats at dawn, witness the divine Ganga Aarti ceremony, seek blessings at Kashi Vishwanath, and explore the Buddhist Sarnath where Gautam Buddha delivered his first sermon.
highlights: Sunrise boat ride through 84 sacred ghats
Evening Dashashwamedh Ghat Ganga Aarti ceremony
Kashi Vishwanath Temple & Corridor tour
Sarnath Buddhist Stupa & Archaeological Museum
inclusions: 3 Nights in heritage/boutique hotel in Varanasi
Private cab for all transfers & sightseeing

itinerary.title: Arrival in Varanasi & Evening Ganga Aarti
itinerary.description: Arrive at Lal Bahadur Shastri Airport or Varanasi Junction. Check in to hotel. Evening boat ride at Dashashwamedh Ghat to witness the spectacular Ganga Aarti — seven priests offering fire to the sacred Ganges.

itinerary.title: Sunrise Ghats Boat Ride & Kashi Vishwanath
itinerary.description: 4:30 AM sunrise boat ride through Assi Ghat, Manikarnika (sacred cremation ghat), Dasaswamedha Ghat. Morning darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple via the new Kashi Vishwanath Corridor.

itinerary.title: Sarnath Buddhist Tour & Banaras Heritage Walk
itinerary.description: Visit Sarnath — Dhamekh Stupa (where Buddha gave first sermon), Ashoka Pillar, and museum. Afternoon Banaras heritage walk through silk weaving lanes, Chunar Ghats, and famous Banarasi paan.

itinerary.title: Departure from Varanasi
itinerary.description: Morning temple walk at Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple. Transfer to airport/station for departure with divine blessings.

title: Ooty & Coorg Hill Station Getaway: Misty Valleys & Coffee
overview: The perfect South India hills escape — Ooty's Nilgiri toy train, rose garden, and Doddabetta Peak combined with Coorg's misty coffee estates, waterfalls, and Tibetan monastery make for a tranquil and rejuvenating retreat.
highlights: UNESCO Nilgiri Mountain Railway Toy Train Ride
Doddabetta Peak (Nilgiri's highest point at 2,637m)
Coorg Coffee & Cardamom Plantation Guided Walk
Abbey Falls & Golden Temple (Namdroling Monastery)
inclusions: 4 Nights in hill resort (2N Ooty + 2N Coorg)
Toy train ticket (Mettupalayam to Ooty section)

itinerary.title: Coimbatore Arrival & Nilgiri Toy Train to Ooty
itinerary.description: Arrive at Coimbatore Airport/Station. Board the iconic Nilgiri Mountain Railway (UNESCO World Heritage) toy train from Mettupalayam to Ooty — a 5-hour scenic journey through 16 tunnels and 31 bridges.

itinerary.title: Ooty Sightseeing — Gardens, Lakes & Peak
itinerary.description: Visit the Botanical Gardens, Rose Garden (11,000+ varieties), Doddabetta Peak for panoramic Nilgiri views, Ooty Lake boating, and the famous Ooty homemade chocolate factory.

itinerary.title: Ooty to Coorg — Scotland of India
itinerary.description: Drive through misty Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve. Arrive in Coorg (Kodagu). Check in to coffee estate resort. Evening bonfire and Kodava cultural welcome.

itinerary.title: Coorg Coffee Estate & Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Guided morning walk through coffee & cardamom plantation with expert narration. Visit Abbey Falls (22m cascade), Raja's Seat sunset garden, and the Namdroling Tibetan Buddhist Monastery.

itinerary.title: Departure from Coorg / Mysuru
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Mysuru or Mangaluru for onward journey. Optional stop at Cauvery River's Nisargadhama island forest.

title: Golden Triangle Punjab: Amritsar, Wagah & Chandigarh
overview: Experience Punjab's golden heart — the breathtaking Golden Temple with its spiritual Langar, the electrifying Wagah–Attari Border Retreat Ceremony, the sobering Jallianwala Bagh, and Chandigarh's Le Corbusier-designed modernity.
highlights: Sri Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) Darshan & Langar
Wagah–Attari Border Beating Retreat Ceremony
Jallianwala Bagh National Memorial
Rock Garden Chandigarh & Sukhna Lake
inclusions: Private cab for all sightseeing & transfers

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amritsar & Golden Temple Darshan
itinerary.description: Arrive at Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport or Amritsar Railway Station. Transfer to hotel. Evening visit to the illuminated Golden Temple — a truly divine experience. Participate in free community Langar.

itinerary.title: Wagah Border Ceremony & Jallianwala Bagh
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Jallianwala Bagh (poignant 1919 massacre site). Afternoon Partition Museum. Evening thrilling Wagah–Attari Border Beating Retreat Ceremony with full nationalist fervour.

itinerary.title: Amritsar Local & Drive to Chandigarh
itinerary.description: Morning shopping in Hall Bazaar for Amritsari phuljadi juttis, woollens & dry fruits. Drive to Chandigarh — India's most planned city. Evening at Sukhna Lake & Sector 17 market.

itinerary.title: Chandigarh Sightseeing & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Nek Chand's whimsical Rock Garden (built from recycled waste), Rose Garden, and Capitol Complex. Transfer to Chandigarh Airport/Station for departure.

title: Mount Abu Romantic Retreat: Marble Temples & Nakki Lake
overview: A quick but enchanting escape to Rajasthan's only hill station — the UNESCO-remarkable Dilwara Jain Temples, Nakki Lake sunrise boat ride, Guru Shikhar summit, and the spiritual serenity of Brahma Kumaris World Headquarters.
highlights: Dilwara Jain Temples — India's finest marble artistry
Nakki Lake sunrise boat ride
Guru Shikhar Peak (1,722m) — highest in Aravalli
Sunset Point & Honeymoon Point viewpoints
exclusions: Dilwara Temple entry (free, no camera allowed)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mount Abu & Nakki Lake Evening
itinerary.description: Arrive at Abu Road Station. Drive up the winding Aravalli road to Mount Abu. Check in to hotel. Evening Nakki Lake boating and stroll on Mount Abu's main market road.

itinerary.title: Dilwara Temples, Guru Shikhar & Sunset Point
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Dilwara Jain Temples (11th-13th century marble carvings — no photography). Drive to Guru Shikhar Peak for panoramic Aravalli views. Afternoon at Trevor's Tank Crocodile Sanctuary. Sunset Point for colours over the Rajasthan plains.

itinerary.title: Brahma Kumaris & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning meditation session at Brahma Kumaris World Spiritual University (Om Shanti Bhavan). Visit Achalgarh Fort. Transfer to Abu Road for onward journey.

title: Spiti Valley High-Altitude Trek & Monastery Circuit
overview: The road less travelled — Spiti's stark cold desert moonscapes, ancient Buddhist monasteries at 4,000m+, Chandratal Lake, and the world's highest post office at Hikkim. A true adventure for the soul.
highlights: Chandratal (Moon Lake) at 4,250m — camping under stars
Key Monastery (Ki Gompa) — 1,000-year-old monastery
Hikkim — World's Highest Post Office
Kibber village & Chicham bridge — Asia's highest gorge bridge
inclusions: 7 Nights (mix of guesthouses, homestays & tent camping)
Private SUV/Innova with experienced Spiti driver
exclusions: Airfare / train to Manali or Shimla

itinerary.title: Manali to Kaza via Rohtang & Kunzum La
itinerary.description: Drive from Manali over Rohtang Pass and the dramatic Kunzum La (4,590m). Arrive in Kaza — the sub-divisional headquarters of Spiti at 3,800m. Acclimatise.

itinerary.title: Kaza Local Sightseeing — Key Monastery & Kibber
itinerary.description: Visit the 1,000-year-old Key Monastery (Ki Gompa) perched on a hilltop. Drive to Kibber village (4,270m) and see the Chicham Gorge Bridge — Asia's highest.

itinerary.title: Hikkim, Komic & Langza Villages
itinerary.description: Post a letter from Hikkim — the world's highest post office. Visit Komic village (world's highest motorable village). Explore Langza's Buddha statue amid lunar-like landscape.

itinerary.title: Pin Valley National Park Day Trip
itinerary.description: Drive into the lush Pin Valley — a striking contrast to barren Spiti. Visit Pin Valley National Park (home to endangered Snow Leopard), Kungri Monastery, and Mud village.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Tabo Monastery
itinerary.description: Drive to Tabo — home to the 1,000-year-old Tabo Monastery (UNESCO tentative list). Explore its ancient frescoes and meditation caves used by the Dalai Lama.

itinerary.title: Tabo to Dhankar & Chandratal Camp
itinerary.description: Visit cliff-hanging Dhankar Gompa. Afternoon drive to Chandratal Lake (Moon Lake) at 4,250m. Overnight tent camping under a sky blazing with stars.

itinerary.title: Chandratal Sunrise & Return to Manali
itinerary.description: Wake before dawn for Chandratal's incredible golden sunrise. Begin the return drive over Kunzum La and Rohtang to Manali.

itinerary.title: Departure from Manali
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, transfer to Manali bus stand or Bhuntar Airport for your onward journey.
